projects.honda_title: Workshop Revitalization & Epoxy Coating - Honda Dealership
projects.honda_desc: Complete execution of high-standard physical revitalization for the service center at the Honda Dealership. Application of high-gloss self-leveling epoxy coating with high mechanical and chemical resistance, technical demarcation of workspace zones, safety paths, and hydraulic lift limits.
projects.honda_point1: Premium aesthetic finish with a glossy and reflective self-leveling surface.
projects.honda_point2: Technical color-coding: service zones (green), vehicle traffic (red/brown), and safety lines (yellow).
projects.honda_point3: High mechanical resistance to heavy loads and chemical resistance to oils and automotive fluids.
projects.honda_point4: Logistical markings with safety borders and high-contrast direction arrows.
projects.p1_desc: High-performance corporate dashboard built with TypeScript and Next.js. The system orchestrates multiple independent micro-frontends, consuming real-time data via WebSockets and optimized GraphQL queries.
projects.p1_point1: Pages with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and optimized loading.
projects.p1_point2: Strict static typing and complex reactive state control.
projects.p1_point3: Advanced accessibility following WCAG and WAI-ARIA guidelines.
projects.p1_point4: Support for multiple themes and modular design system.
projects.p2_desc: Critical routing service and API gateway developed in Go and Rust. Capable of managing thousands of requests per second with low latency, integrating Rate Limiting in Redis and gRPC communication.
projects.p2_point1: Developed in Go (Gin) and Rust (Axum) with native concurrency.
projects.p2_point2: Highly normalized and indexed PostgreSQL relational database.
projects.p2_point3: Distributed rate limiting with Redis Token Bucket.
projects.p2_point4: Rigorous unit testing and automated pipeline in GitHub Actions.
projects.p3_desc: Intelligent AI agent built with LlamaIndex and PyTorch for semantic search in distributed knowledge bases, using vector databases (Vector DB) for highly relevant contextual retrieval.
projects.p3_point1: Optimized RAG pipeline for low latency in semantic queries.
projects.p3_point2: Use of local embeddings and fine-tuning with PyTorch.
projects.p3_point3: In-memory vector indexing with Pinecone and FAISS.
projects.p3_point4: Lightweight container deployment with GPU-accelerated execution support.
projects.p4_desc: Data architecture for cloud distributed processing using Apache Spark and Terraform IAC. Fully containerized under Kubernetes clusters on AWS with structured CI/CD.
projects.p4_point1: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and AWS.
projects.p4_point2: Complete container orchestration in Kubernetes cluster (EKS).
projects.p4_point3: High-performance distributed ETL pipelines with Apache Spark.
projects.p4_point4: Total deployment automation with GitLab CI and Docker Registry.
